notes.title: Alone in the Crowd - Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
What's new?

-Fixed citizen's animations.
-Lamp posts are back.
-Fixed bug where following the "Chosen" path was impossible due to a lack of citizens with the same surname.
-Changed the data box entry from "Camera coordinates" to "Target coordinates".
-I changed some dialogs with Boxy.
-Added a compass to the Eye.
-Added a huge camera icon on the Network.
-The clear filter button on the wheel report should completely clear all filters now.
-Made some minor fixes to texts.
-Reduced joystick sensitivity (on the Eye gadget).
-Added a lock gadget in place toggle.
-Added a play/pause button on the Eye.
-Added a few new face parts.
-Added a reset seed option on the main menu screen.
-Used an updated version of Unity that might fix other problems.

Thanks, everybody for the feedback =)

notes.title: Alone in the Crowd - Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
List of changes:
Added a new toggle on the Rainbow Path allowing the player to filter citizens based on Wheel Report's filter choices.

Corrected and added new information on the Data Box.

Added an option to skip a few intro missions IF the player owns a special card.

Tweaked the color palette of some gadget screens.

Fixed a few bugs and added a few more.

Increased the chance of Shy citizens to Teamplay in the Playground and/or Party in the Lounge. It was impossible for some players to finish the game before this fix. I'm very sorry to all affected =(

Added 9 new Steam achievements.

Highlighted building types on the hologram table will now also highlight respective building tiles on the network gadget map.

Thank you all for the reviews, feedback, and reports.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Minor fixes.
Included a seed number indicator on the Main Menu.

notes.title: Alone i the Crowd release day!
notes.content:
It's been a while, but it's finally done.
Alone in the Crowd is a puzzle simulation investigative thriller, where you use a weird variety of gadgets to satisfy this mysterious, self-proclaimed friendly AI character.

Come discuss what you like or dislike about the game, I'm all ears now.
You could try the demo if you're still undecided about what the game is about.

Hope you guys have fun =)
